description: Clean up text line by line with a fixed pipeline (same order as the website): strip HTML tags and decode entities → remove emojis → trim each line → collapse repeated spaces → remove empty lines → remove duplicate lines (optionally ignoring case) → sort (A–Z, Z–A, natural, by length) → reverse → shuffle (seedable) → add line numbers. Returns the cleaned text plus counts, or writes it to a file when "output" is given. Give "text" or a text file "path". Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/text-cleaner/

collapseSpaces.description: Collapse runs of spaces/tabs into one space (default true).

ignoreCase.description: When removing duplicates, treat lines that differ only in case as duplicates (default false).

numberLines.description: Prefix each line with its number ("1. ", padded) (default false).

output.description: Optional: write the cleaned text to this file path (or folder ending in "/") instead of returning it.

path.description: Or: a path to a UTF-8 text file.

removeDuplicates.description: Remove duplicate lines, keeping the first (default false).

removeEmoji.description: Remove emojis (©, ® and ™ are kept) (default false).

seed.description: Seed for a reproducible shuffle (default: random).

sort.description: Sort lines: none (default), az, za, natural (item 2 before item 10), length (shortest first).

stripHtml.description: Strip HTML tags (drops script/style/comments, block ends become line breaks) and decode entities (default false).

trim.description: Trim spaces at the start and end of each line (default true).

name: text_clean
title: Text cleaner
